name: create-redbelly-dapp
description: Scaffold an identity-gated dApp for Redbelly Network: Foundry contracts on the Gated base, a Next.js + wagmi web app, CI, rules files for coding agents, npm run dev for the local loop, doctor, gas and ship, and a deploy script that refuses chain 151 without a Safe 1.4.1, a verified deployer and a ship report dated today. --hardhat adds a Hardhat 3 view of the same sources.

scripts.test: npm run build:siblings && node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-concurrency=1 test/integration.test.mjs test/dev.test.mjs
scripts.prepack: node --check bin/index.js && npm run test:unit && node scripts/sync-recipes.mjs
